name: riot-loader
description: Riot Loader — LoL Client Companion Platform & Native Loader (Fork of Pengu Loader)

scripts.build: pnpm --filter pengujs build && pnpm --filter riot-loader build && pnpm --filter companion-app build
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter pengujs exec tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter riot-loader exec vue-tsc --noEmit && pnpm --filter companion-app exec vue-tsc --noEmit
